sections.title: I. Largo misterioso (The Shadow of Grief)
sections.character: Solitary, grief-stricken recitative; Neapolitan sighs & lamento bass

sections.title: II. Andante cantabile dolente (The Memory of Lost Love)
sections.character: Noble, singing Chopin/Kreisler cantabile melody; circular ABBA lamento progression

sections.title: III. Poco a poco agitato (The Flight of Icarus)
sections.character: Surging, liquid 16th-note wave arpeggios soaring towards the upper stratosphere

sections.title: IV. Grandioso e disperato (The Climax & The Fall)
sections.character: Fortissimo tragic catharsis; thunderous double octaves & torrential chromatic fall

sections.title: V. Adagio lacrimoso (Whisper Codetta & Far Farewell)
sections.character: Fading tears, music-box echoes, fragile Picardy third dissolving into silence
